name: mia-vad-2b
architecture: Qwen3_5ForCausalLM read as a System One decision model (decider): option-letter logits at the answer slot
emotion_temperature_note: decider applies temperature by answer type and sentiment/emotion are both choice; decider_config.json holds the sentiment temperature as choice, so rescale emotion as p^(1.04/1.2) and renormalize
score_value: expected level under the probabilities (valence minus 3 gives -3..3)
training_data: Mia's 76,112 sentiment rows; 42,000 new Chinese short texts with six labels (rare emotions repeated to 48,578 rows), not distributed; 22,004 replay rows of decider teacher_data (15%)
labels_of_new_texts: Qwen3.8-27B labeled every candidate under a written rubric; a second LLM re-labeled a random 20% plus the rows where Qwen's rare emotions were unreliable; a third LLM labeled the 2,000 gold texts and corrected 3,000 rows where the others disagreed; emotion is learned only where two labelers agree, sentiment only where it agrees with mia-decider-2b
trainer: python -m decider.train (decider-ai 1.5.0), 1 epoch, lr 8e-6, warmup 180, schema_first_prob 0.5, none_prob 0, seed 0

eval.gold_note: 2,000 texts labeled by an LLM under a written rubric, not by people; 1,454 drawn at random, 546 added for rare emotions

smp2020_ewect_usual_test_4998.note: no disgust class in EWECT; predicted 厌恶 counted as wrong

throughput: 67 texts/s on RTX 4090 (bf16, batch 32, CUDA graph, one row per question)
